description: FDA Complete Response Letters — Search FDA Complete Response Letters (drug/biologic rejection letters FDA has published) by company=, application= (NDA/BLA number), q= (phrase in the letter text), year=, status= approved|unapproved (whether the product was later approved), limit= 1-20. Returns date, company, applications, later-approved flag, deficiency themes (manufacturing, CMC, efficacy, safety, labeling, REMS...) and a text excerpt. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
